name: Pimavanserin
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: CYP3A4/CYP3A5 dominate metabolism. CYP3A4 forms active N-desmethylpimavanserin (AC-279), which persists longer than the parent. Very little parent drug is eliminated unchanged in urine.
